The operator approves or amends it; registration copies it to specs/release-requirements.v8.json and moves CURRENT_RELEASE_SPEC in one change. docs/records/evals/2026-11-14-release-requirements-v8-proposal.md gives the measured basis of every value.
rationale: Proposed version 8 registers the evaluation collections frozen from corpus v0.8.18-retention-overlay: heldout-dev-v0.8.18 (version 187e8ab06b37351c, seed 1818) for development and heldout-confirm-v0.8.18 (version 35ba77d61aa40921, seed 1819, drawn with every development group excluded) for confirmation, and names the confirmation collection as the dataset identity. Every threshold, selector, statistic, provenance rule and identity other than identities.dataset and evaluations is version 7's. Confirmation reads before registration: none; the published model's baseline scoring on confirmation (6.5) has not been run.

The minimum mirrors the 0.85 of the other capabilities in the v3 decision record.

inference.description: HELDOUT_INFERENCE_RULE in heldout/per/country.ts (served-locale-package): each row is parsed by the shipped Latin locale package for its country (release.config.json locales), falling back to en-us, with the row's country as localeHint; a package whose loader reports an unfed required channel is refused. The verdict records the rule and the rows each package parsed.

statistics.groupingAssumption: A row's independent unit is its group within its country: base_source_id when derived, else source_id. Rows are not declared independent, so a check that reads an ungrouped row is insufficient evidence. Limitation: structure shared across groups (one source's conventions, one place's many addresses) is not modelled. The dataset quota counts groups, not rows, against 1,000 per country.
